source: W20 Gifts (pp. 152-200): the W20 Gifts the Dark Ages library does not already hold by name
note: Pool, difficulty, cost and duration follow the W20 System lines; effect text is a short summary with the page to check.

gifts.e: A turn of focus; each success takes one off the difficulty of the next roll made with a human-made tool.
Climbs city walls and fixtures at full speed; Athletics rolls to move through streets get easier for the scene.
Made things of the chosen complexity within 50 feet stop working for two turns per success.
Someone met this scene carries the Curse as if they had the Garou's Rage, one day per success.
Two extra soak dice against made weapons that are not silver, for the scene.
The target regains no Rage this scene, and extended actions grow harder for that target.
Moves one physical Attribute dot to another per two successes, for the scene.
A hard shell forms for a day (more Gnosis renews it); blows weaker than Stamina + Rituals do nothing until one breaks it.
Always on: humans single the Garou out as striking and important; the Curse makes the Garou imposing rather than frightening.
One success shields a human from the Delirium for the scene; later exposure costs that person memories.
Once a scene: take one aggravated level of damage and gain three Rage, even past the permanent rating.
Squeezes through any gap that fits the head, at walking pace, for the scene.
Digs through earth or stone; harder ground takes a higher difficulty and some metals will not give.
Always on: shapeshifting difficulties drop by one and a change needs no success just to begin.
Others need a Perception roll against the Garou's Wits + Stealth to spot the Garou, until it attacks.
Shielded against all mind-bending magic for the scene.
Roll Rage: one unsoakable aggravated level per success to a target within 100 yards; safe once a scene.
A bite that lands deals double damage after soak.
Always on: partial changes can grow odd limbs or organs, each giving one of a set of listed benefits.
Finds enough prey to feed a pack for a day (difficulty 7 in a city).
A turn of focus gives lethal claws and fangs in Homid for the scene, easy to hide.
Each success adds a die to escape, hide or shake pursuit for the scene (difficulty 9 in a city).
Always on: the Garou always knows which way it faces and travels while in the physical world.
Clear sight reaches one extra mile per success.
Always on: falls under 100 feet do no harm, footing never slips, and body slams and grapples are two easier.
A prehensile tail in any tailed form; using it calls for Dexterity + Athletics.
A howl destroys delicate electronics within 20 yards per success.
Lupus form gains four Strength instead of one, for the scene.
Everyone within 50 feet but the pack is knocked down and takes one unsoakable bashing level per success.
Full Delirium strikes everyone human or once human who sees the Garou, even vampires and mages.
Those who hear the joke let go of their anger and forget what upset them (difficulty is the highest listener's Rage).
A truthful statement is heard as a lie; humans always fall for it.
Opens any lock or seal; a magical seal costs a Gnosis point first.
Learns where a named person or spirit is; a roll is needed only if the target is hiding.
Listens in on a phone call or reads text messages while touching the line or watching the user.
After a theft, three successes erase the victim's memory of ever owning the item.
Damages a machine; one success causes a fault and three break it for good.
A lie is believed: one success sways one listener, three sway a crowd.
Each success cuts travel time by about a tenth (at most half) and makes the trail harder to track.
A dodge at +1 difficulty (or the Gauntlet); if it fully avoids the blow, the attacker is thrown across the Gauntlet.
Resisted Gnosis roll: each success takes a point from one of the victim's Physical Attributes.
Takes the shape of any ordinary animal; further changes this scene cost no more Gnosis.
An attack on a spirit within 30 feet that cuts its Willpower in combat by two for the scene.
A silver cord marks the way back from the Umbra; each full day there costs a Gnosis point to keep it.
Spirits other than the pack totem lose one Essence a turn within 50 feet per success.
Three turns of focus drive a spirit out of a place or person; a bound spirit needs more successes than its binder got.
Unseen by spirit senses for the scene, until it attacks.
The Garou and close pack travel the Pattern Web as if on a moon bridge.
Up to five targets face a Gauntlet five higher for the scene.
Resisted Gnosis: the spirit loses one Essence per success; every two drained gives the Garou a temporary Willpower.
Destroys one Intelligence dot per two Gnosis spent, for good.
Three successes leave the target dazed by the argument and unable to act with purpose (difficulty is the target's Wits + Enigmas).
For a day, natural weapons deal two extra damage dice to beings that fell into the Wyrm's service.
All present fall silent and listen; leaving or interrupting costs a Willpower point.
One animal within 100 feet obeys until released.
Seals a witnessed oath; the Garou knows when it is broken and tracks the oathbreaker by scent far more easily.
Feels whether Wyrm, Weaver or Wyld holds sway in the area.
Each success is a bonus die to split between attack and damage against that foe.
Meditation recalls the wisdom of ancestors on a question; more successes give a fuller answer (one easier per dot of Ancestors).
Forces shapechangers back to their breed or true form, one turn per success.
Raises a stone wall (soak 10, 15 health levels) that can ring the Garou and close allies.
Links chosen minds in a shared waking dream to talk; unwilling ones need a roll.
Remembers any single detail from any point in life, perfectly.
Enters a sleeper's dream and can talk with them there; waking throws the Garou out and costs a Gnosis.
Wyrm creatures who hear the howl wake and cannot sleep for three hours per success.
Three successes make the target come to the Garou; fewer start the target moving that way.
A long heroic tale: every two successes add one to an Ability for all listening Garou and Kinfolk.
Those in earshot (not packmates) are spellbound and cannot act, one turn per success.
Opens a moon bridge up to the Garou's Gnosis in miles; three Willpower keeps it to the next full moon.
Breathes a crafted dream into a sleeper's mouth; more successes make it more vivid and lasting.
Pulls others into a shadow-play: they act out the tale until it ends or they are attacked.
Extended roll: builds a dream creature with one dot of Traits per success.
Steers one person's feelings for the scene.
Splits dice equal to Leadership among everyone in a pack maneuver.
The next claw that hits stays in the wound: +2 difficulty to all actions until the victim pulls the claws out.
Spirits' Rage counts two lower when they roll damage against the Ahroun, for the scene.
Always on: heals one non-aggravated level every turn in combat, with no roll.
This turn every attack ignores armour, mundane or magical.
After a bite hits, holds on and bites again each turn at difficulty 3; breaking free hurts the victim.
A turn of focus heals three bashing or two lethal levels; a Willpower more heals one aggravated level instead.
The target heals no damage by any means, one turn per success (difficulty is the lower of its Rage or Willpower minus 3).
The target drops to its knees unless it spends a point of Gnosis or other mystic power to resist.
The next attack that lands rolls double damage dice.
A claw that hits keeps burrowing: one unsoakable lethal level each turn until dug out or the victim dies.
Wound penalties from this turn's blows count double for the rest of the scene.
Grows wings that fly at 50 miles an hour until dismissed.
Fires claws like a gun (medium range 20 yards), dealing claw damage.
Eye contact paralyses the victim one turn per success; five successes turn the victim to stone.
Makes a meal from anything at hand: it feeds one person per success.
Adds a die to a Feat of Strength for each bashing level the Garou chooses to take.
The target reeks and suffers −1 to all actions for an hour per success.
A broken object works perfectly, with its own power or ammunition, one turn per success.
Finds a hidden corner of the city to vanish into; more successes make it harder to find.
Each success adds a Brawl die for the fight, but the Bone Gnawer falls into berserk frenzy.
Looks like an ordinary stray dog, one scene per success.
Everyone but the pack within 20 feet who can smell loses two dice from all pools.
A spray (range 10 feet) makes the target retch for a turn unless Willpower is spent, then −1 dice per two successes.
Rots wood and paper: one success ruins a ream, three a wall, five bring down a small roof.
Always on: while the Garou laughs at them, mind control attempts are at +2 difficulty.
Floods a building with vermin; five successes make it unfit to live in for a long time.
Spirits drive the crowd against a chosen target across a mile per success; it tends to spiral.
Needs no food, water or sleep, one day per success; a second Gnosis adds three Stamina and ignores wound penalties for ten turns, then ends it.
Anyone not on guard overlooks how out of place the Garou looks.
Made weapons in earshot do not work, one turn per success.
All damage from the Garou's own body is bashing for the scene; foes it would kill only fall unconscious.
Each success strips one Rage from the target; it ends frenzy in creatures without Rage.
In a fight others started, +1 Strength and Dexterity against whoever struck first.
Grows a horn and hooves; anyone wounded by them loses two attack dice until the wound heals.
A warm touch heals one bashing or lethal level per success.
For one turn per success the target is barred from Rage: every Rage roll fails, no frenzy, no spending it.
One foe cannot hit the Garou this scene, until the Garou attacks it.
Always outruns its pursuers, one scene per success.
Holds two different talks at once; each listener hears only the version meant for them.
The listener agrees with the Garou entirely, one turn per success (difficulty is the listener's Wits + Alertness).
Dodges one attack with the full pool whatever else was done this turn, or adds three dice to a dodge.
Speech or a howl carries across the Gauntlet, one turn per success.
Calls faeries to help; more Gnosis brings stronger ones and more successes bring more.
Once a scene, rerolls a failed or botched roll; the new result stands.
An hour of chanting summons the Huntsman and hounds (one more per extra Rage or Gnosis) to run down a wrongdoer.
For a day, abort to a defence with no Willpower roll or cost.
Icy fangs and claws: anyone they wound suffers −1 for the scene from the chill.
A turn-long snarl: each success takes a die from the foe's pools for three turns (difficulty is the foe's Wits + 3).
An extra soak die per success for the scene (not against silver); +1 to Social rolls except Intimidation.
Anyone touching the Garou's blood this scene takes a die of aggravated damage per success.
Cannot fail a Stamina task for the scene (soak excepted); torture cannot break the Garou.
Each success adds a die to Physical pools; cannot be surprised and every attack counts as frontal, but the Garou cannot move until the foes fall or flee.
Stamina doubles for the scene.
The next bite that hits cripples a limb and deals three automatic unsoakable aggravated levels (difficulty is the foe's Stamina + 3).
Makes a simple machine work on command for the scene.
Knows at once what is wrong with a broken machine; its spirit helps, and repairs take half the time.
For a day, any computer used connects with any other device, whatever the system or ports.
An extra action, and for the scene the Garou attacks without needing to see, ignoring sight and off-hand penalties.
Defending helpless kin or pack: one extra die to all Physical Attributes for the scene.
Persuades an Eastern or urban elemental (chosen when learned) to do a favour with its physical shell.
Cannot fail a Stamina task for the scene (soak excepted); torture cannot break the Garou.
Each success lets one packmate heal as many levels, aggravated included, as there were successes.
Always on: adds permanent Glory to the pool for a wild trick shot; it cannot do direct harm to a target.
Swaps a natural sense for a machine one, such as radar hearing or infrared sight.
Each Rage spent deals two aggravated levels, split among up to that many foes.
An urban elemental does a favour with its shell: glass bursts, a door sticks, brakes fail.
Travels down a phone line to a connected phone up to Gnosis × 5 miles away.
Guns fired by the Garou never run dry this scene.
Blacks out power: one success a room, five a whole neighbourhood.
One soak die per success for the scene; +1 to Dexterity rolls and to most Social rolls.
Takes control of a complex machine, such as a computer, for the scene.
For one minute every lock and barrier lets the Garou through; each success adds one against magical seals.
Sends a message through any machine; farther targets take a higher difficulty.
Always on: may spend Rage and Gnosis in the same turn.
A Net-Spider comes and obeys, and computer rolls become far easier from then on.
Sees which of a group is strongest, weakest and in charge; +1 attack die against the weakest.
Licking each kill makes the wounds look like knife cuts, not bites or claws.
The human dreads going outside and must roll Willpower to leave home, one day per success.
Each success lets what the Garou eats also feed one more being.
Marks a predator in sight and can then sense through it, as Territory.
Help arrives within the hour from crocodile kin or the spirits of the old pact.
Always on: causes Delirium in Hispo, and in Crinos those who see it count as five Willpower lower.
Touching a made material melts twenty pounds of it per success.
Senses what happens at any place it has marked, up to Gnosis places.
A howl deals one lethal level per success (soakable) as the target's insides burst.
A werewolf is locked in Lupus for the scene; a human or animal becomes an ordinary wolf for good.
The target takes a bashing level each turn it touches anything man-made.
Shapes shadows within 100 yards for the scene; Stealth and Intimidation are one easier.
Hears every whisper within 200 feet for the scene.
A paper crane folded in a turn: each success is a spare die to add to any roll this scene, once each.
Washing the hand in clean water adds a die to Appearance rolls for the scene.
Strikes a foe up to 50 yards away with a blade; the foe may dodge.
Spilled ink blinds the victim, an hour per success.
Each success makes the spirit of a touched object tell one fact about itself.
Raises a storm a mile across per success; each Rage spent adds a success.
The attacker holds off one turn per success unless attacked.
Ten minutes of communion: the earth tells of supernatural beings nearby.
Takes hold of a frenzying target and sets it on anyone, two turns per success.
Anyone meaning harm must beat the Garou's successes on Willpower (difficulty 8) to act against it.
Freezes the target in place, one turn per success; it may still defend.
A touch curses the target: missiles hit it more easily, one day per success.
If the next attack harms, the target bleeds one unsoakable lethal level a turn, one turn per success.
Keeps a used talen's spirit from leaving, so the talen can be used again.
Always on: two extra dice on Dexterity + Stealth rolls.
Sees and hears ghosts and senses haunted places for the scene.
Walks across water and other liquids as if on ground, an hour per success.
A mark that leaves the area badly haunted, one week per success.
A claw strike leaves the target haunted, one day per level of damage dealt.
Strength counts three higher for grapples and holds, for the scene.
An arm becomes a sword dealing Strength + 2 aggravated damage, for the scene.
Always on: while the Silver Fang is with the pack, everyone gets a die on Pack Tactics rolls.
A blade burns: two extra dice of aggravated fire damage, sets things alight, one turn per success.
A claw attack that deals three extra levels, which cannot regenerate this scene.
One command a Garou must obey, one turn per success (difficulty is the target's Wits + 3).
Always on: mind control, mind reading, illusions and possession aimed at the Garou are difficulty 10.
Always on: climbing is three easier and keeping balance always works.
Spends up to three Rage on one action, each giving an extra die.
Once a scene, a spent Willpower gives two automatic successes instead of one.
Always on: steps sideways as if holding a mirror, with none needed.
Five minutes of focus turn one Rage into one Willpower per success.
Each success makes supernatural coercion of the Garou one harder; ordinary coercion fails outright.
Crosses water, mud, snow and quicksand at full speed without sinking or leaving tracks.
Changes one square foot of an element into another per success (fire to wood, water to earth).
Sees through fog, darkness and illusions that the roll beats; no sight penalties.
Blows harm without leaving marks; a foe put down this way wakes unhurt.
Each success cancels one of a close attacker's successes; enough left over turns the blow back on the attacker.
Foes lose one die to hit the Garou per success, even unseen attacks.
Each success dodges one attack perfectly or turns it onto another target.

gifts.n: Harmonious Unity of the Emerald Mother
gifts.e: For a day, gains Crinos physical bonuses and healing while in Homid, without claws or Delirium.
Asks the Storyteller one simple question and gets an honest, symbolic answer.
Senses magic in use nearby; three successes hint at its kind.
Blacks out a ten-foot cube in sight per success.
Walks on walls and ceilings at walking pace for the scene.
Each success raises a 30-foot coil of mist within 100 feet that grapples a target.
Calls hidden fetishes to hand, or sends them back to their hiding place.
What the Garou told the target vanishes from memory at the next sunrise.
Flies at 20 miles an hour and hovers for an hour; combat moves are one harder.
Breathes water and swims freely, an hour per success.
A known pack loses its totem's Traits and cannot use pack tactics for the scene.
Each success weakens one spirit within 200 feet: its Rage, Gnosis and Willpower roll one lower for the scene.
Unseen unless a searcher beats the successes on Perception + Alertness (difficulty 8).
A claw strike ends one ongoing magic power boosting the target.
Watches a far place for the scene (difficulty 8 with something from it).
Summons an elemental for the scene; Manipulation + Occult wins its help.
Moves an object by will at about 20 miles an hour, one turn per success.
A week-built doll of the victim: each success deals one aggravated level from afar.
With a token of the quarry, hears its heartbeat and can track it.
A cold wind: those caught lose a Perception die, and −1 to all actions after a minute without warm clothes.
Always on: in the wilderness, spotting the Garou is three harder.
One success shows the stitched patchwork of a Skin Dancer's stolen skin.
Hides the Wyrm taint from senses that seek it, one scene per success.
An intangible double of the Garou appears within 100 feet, seen and heard as the real one.
A gust (medium range 20 yards): anyone hit loses two dice for two turns and can be knocked over.
Icy fangs and claws: anyone they wound suffers −1 for the scene from the chill.
Moves freely on or under water, one scene per success, and leaps like a hare.
Talks with wind-spirits; in the physical world a roll asks them one question.
Always on: ignores cold penalties, five extra soak dice against cold, Survival in cold is two easier.
After a bite draws blood, gains a Strength dot per two levels dealt, for the scene.
Runs through the sky at 50 miles an hour for four hours, trailing fire; stopping means falling.
A three-turn dance calls Wendigo's spirit to kill a chosen victim; failure turns it on the summoner.
Drops the temperature below freezing for five miles around.

gifts.n: Invoke the Spirits of the Storm
gifts.e: Calls up a storm ten miles across per success; lightning can be aimed.
Each success is one unsoakable aggravated level, dealt one a turn.
An illusion ten feet across per Gnosis; doubters must beat the successes to see through it.
Untouched by poison, disease and hostile surroundings (pressure, heat, cold, air), an hour per success.
